01

“and We removed from you your burden”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 94:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
and We removed from you your burden [al-Sharh: 2], he said: “your sin in the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic era).”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَوَضَعْنَا عَنْكَ وِزْرَكَ [الشرح: 2] قَالَ: «ذَنْبَكَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»

02

“which weighed upon your back”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 94:3).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
which weighed upon your back [al-Sharh: 3], “meaning it burdened your back.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
الَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ [الشرح: 3] «يَعْنِي أَثْقَلَ ظَهْرَكَ»

03

“Indeed, with hardship comes ease”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 94:5).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Indeed, with hardship comes ease [al-Sharh: 5], he says: “He made ease follow hardship, and He made ease follow hardship.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا [الشرح: 5] يَقُولُ: «أتْبَعَ الْعُسْرَ يُسْرًا، وَأَتْبَعَ الْعُسْرَ يُسْرًا»
Edition record 373876 · p. 736Link to report ↗
04

“So when you have finished, then strive”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 94:7).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
So when you have finished, then strive [al-Sharh: 7], he said: “He says: when you stand for prayer, strive earnestly in your need of your Lord.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ [الشرح: 7] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ، فَانْصَبْ فِي حَاجَتِكَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ "
Edition record 373877 · p. 736Link to report ↗
05
Report from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said:
“He says: when you have finished with the affairs of this world and stand for prayer, then direct your desire and intention to God (ﷻ).”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" يَقُولُ: إِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا فَقُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ، فَاجْعَلْ رَغْبَتَكَ وَنِيَّتَكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ عز وجل "
